description: This file defines a React functional component named 'ReminderList' that displays a list of reminder items as cards. It allows editing reminders via a callback prop, toggling their completion status, and deleting them. The component utilizes external context 'useReminders' for state management and interacts with reminder objects including properties like id, title, description, date, time, and completion status.

methods.name: ReminderList({ reminders, onEdit })
methods.description: React functional component that displays reminders as cards with options to edit, delete, and mark complete.
